nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study used GAMLSS (generalized additive model for location, scale, and shape) to estimate normative age-related trends and compute centile scores for regional brain volumes. The model was developed by Bethlehem et al. (2022) using approximately 120,000 participants and was applied to benchmark regional volumes against normative trajectories.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: To benchmark regional volumes of each psychosis-related diagnosis and group against normative trajectories, we used a generalized additive model for location, scale, and shape (GAMLSS). This model, available at https://github.com/brainchart/Lifespan, estimated cross-sectional normative age-related trends from 100 different studies (around 120,000 participants)
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: Centile and effect sizes estimation and analysis section

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical gray matter regional volumes (DK atlas); 34 regional centiles averaged across hemispheres.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: “we generated centile scores for cortical gray matter (GM) phenotypes, identifying deviations in regional volumes”; “Cortical brain parcellation was performed using Desikan-Killiany (DK) atlas, and volumetric measurements were derived for each region-of-interest.”; “only 34 DK regional centiles (instead of 68) could be derived for each individual.”
nm2_2_response_variable.location: GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: ARTICLE OPEN Molecular and micro-architectural mapping of gray matter alterations in psychosis; GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: MRI acquisition, parcellation, and volume extraction; GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: Centile and effect sizes estimation and analysis

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The GAMLSS normative model accounts for age (via non-linear age-related trends), sex (sex-stratified measures), and site effects (study-specific offsets for mean, variance, and skewness). These covariates are used to generate age-normed, sex-stratified, and site-corrected centile scores.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: age-normed and sex-stratified measures of brain structure atypicalities across the lifespan, known as centiles, could be derived... a subject at the 20th centile would have a volume that is 'approximately' lower than 80% of individuals of the same age and sex after adjusting for scanning site offset
